index.title: Simulated pedestrian flows and OpenStreetMap QA in Brussels
index.description: Map of simulated pedestrian flows in Brussels built from OpenStreetMap, with quality-control layers to fix sidewalks and crossings.

nav.placeStart: Click on the map to set the start

note.notChecked: not checked: the way ends at the crossing node

sidewalk.yes: sidewalk=yes, to be mapped as separate

missingCrossing.missingWayProblem: No footway connected to the node
missingCrossing.missingTagProblem: Footway connected but without the footway=crossing tag
missingCrossing.wrongTagProblem: The way crossing the road at the crossing node has footway={{value}} instead of footway=crossing

crossingCandidate.problem: Connects a sidewalk on each side of a road but lacks the footway=crossing tag

reason.valueMismatch: Kerb tactile_paving differs from the crossing's
reason.incorrectNotMixed: incorrect expected: one kerb yes + one kerb no

island.levelProblem: Steps whose level=* does not overlap that of a directly connected way: the link is theoretically impassable
island.unjoinedProblem: Almost touches the main network but shares no node with it
island.isolatedProblem: Group of ways with no link to the main network

kerb.missingProblem: No barrier=kerb or kerb=no node found at this end
kerb.untaggedProblem: barrier=kerb or kerb=no node present but without a tactile_paving tag

completeness.title: Pedestrian network completeness
completeness.intro: Average of the five indicators below. The calculation is described in the {{link}}.

sidewalkSeparate.label: Sidewalks mapped separately
sidewalkSeparate.hint: all existing sidewalks mapped as separate (ideal form)

crossingsTagged.label: Fully tagged crossings
crossingsTagged.hint: footway=crossing present on the connected way

continuity.label: Sidewalk continuity
continuity.hint: roads with a sidewalk on both sides, among those with at least one

crossings.title: Pedestrian crossings
crossings.intro: Status of the highway=crossing nodes found on the analysable network.

period.title: Analysis period
period.hint: The vertical scale of the charts adapts to the chosen period, which makes small variations visible. Default: the last 6 months.

compare.title: Since the last monthly snapshot
compare.hwTitle: Km by pedestrian infrastructure type: snapshot vs today
compare.hwSubtitle: Comparison between the last monthly snapshot ({{snapshot}}) and the most recent daily extract ({{today}}). Only dedicated pedestrian infrastructure is compared: roads (primary, etc.) change very little from one day to the next and are covered below.
compare.fwSubtitle: Detail of highway=footway ways by footway=* subtag, same two dates.

network.title: Network length (km)
network.allSubtitle: Pedestrian, road, cycleway. “Road” covers ways from residential to primary where pedestrians walk on the carriageway.
network.hwSubtitle: The six most common types by km.

quality.title: Pedestrian mapping quality
quality.swSubtitle: % of roads (residential → primary) with an explicit sidewalk tag (separate, yes, both, no), and the share still undocumented.
quality.xingSubtitle: A crossing is correctly mapped when it has both a highway=crossing node and a footway=crossing way. The gap between the two curves is the number of crossings left to complete.
quality.accSubtitle: % of footways with surface, % of footways with smoothness, % of crossings with tactile_paving.

footways.title: Footway composition
footways.mixSubtitle: sidewalk / crossing / link / traffic_island / other / no tag. “Other”: a footway=* subtag outside this list; “no tag”: no subtag.

sidewalks.title: Composition of sidewalk tags on roads
sidewalks.mixSubtitle: separate / yes / partial / no / no tag. When roads move from “yes” to “separate”, their sidewalks have been drawn as separate ways.
sidewalks.byTypeSubtitle: Same composition (separate / yes / partial / no / no tag), broken down by road type, for the latest point of the selected period.
sidewalks.noData: Detail by road type not yet available for {{date}}. It will appear after the next extraction.
sidewalks.noDataUndated: Detail by road type not yet available.

status.zoomIn: Zoom in to level {{zoom}} to load candidates.
status.zoomKept_one: Zoom in to level {{zoom}} to load more candidates; the candidate already loaded stays on the map.
status.zoomKept_other: Zoom in to level {{zoom}} to load more candidates; the {{count}} candidates already loaded stay on the map.
status.noMatch: No street without a sidewalk tag matches this place on the dev server.
status.splitOnDev_one: This street matches {{count}} way on the dev server.
status.splitOnDev_other: This street matches {{count}} ways on the dev server (split since the import): pick the right one on the map.

detail.alreadyFixed: No longer matches the whitelist: already fixed since.
detail.gone: {{way}} no longer exists on OSM (deleted or merged).

land.title: OpenStreetMap login
land.ok: Login complete, you can close this window.
land.missing: No login was started from this site. Close this window and start again.
land.expired: The login took too long. Close this window and start again.
land.mismatch: This login was started for another OSM server. Close this window and start again.
land.nocode: This page only completes an OpenStreetMap login.

form.direction: Left and right follow the way's direction: blue on the left, orange on the right.
form.shortcuts: Keys: s, y, n set the value · d different sides · b both sides · → next · p skip · Esc deselect
form.notVisible: This street has not been seen whole yet. Show it whole once before choosing; after that you can zoom in freely.
form.queueFull: This street would open one more area, beyond the {{max}} changesets allowed per upload. Prepare and send the queue before going on here.
form.reviewDetail: Go along the whole street at zoom {{zoom}} or closer before choosing: {{percent}} % seen.
form.reviewNext: Go to the part not seen yet

queue.zones_one: {{count}} changeset out of {{max}} at most per upload.
queue.zones_other: {{count}} changesets out of {{max}} at most per upload.
queue.full: Limit reached: only streets close to the areas already queued can still be added.

upload.commentHelp: Each changeset gets its own comment (street or municipality, then the action), shown in the plan before sending; your remark is added at the end.
upload.sourceTooLong: Sources too long: {{length}} characters, OSM accepts at most {{max}}. Shorten them before sending.
upload.hashtagsTooLong: Hashtags too long: {{length}} characters, OSM accepts at most {{max}}. Shorten them before sending.
upload.tagTooLong: The {{key}} tag is longer than the {{max}} characters OSM accepts.

plan.deleted: deleted on OSM, removed from the queue.
plan.alreadyFixed: already fixed since, removed from the queue.
plan.modifiedMeanwhile: modified meanwhile, removed from the queue.
plan.changesets_one: {{count}} changeset will be created for {{ways}} way(s).
plan.changesets_other: {{count}} changesets will be created for {{ways}} way(s).
plan.tooMany: The queue spreads over {{count}} areas, more than the {{max}} changesets allowed: send part of it first.
plan.changed: The queue changed since it was prepared: check the new plan and send again.
plan.geometryChanged: geometry changed since (reversed or split), removed from the queue.
plan.nodeMoved: a node was moved {{distance}} m since it was queued: check the way's history in iD or JOSM, removed from the queue.

result.retried_one: Conflict detected: the group was re-read and sent again once.
result.retried_other: Conflicts detected: {{count}} groups were re-read and sent again once.
result.conflict_one: {{way}} was modified on OSM meanwhile: nothing was written for its group. It has been removed from the queue; prepare again.
result.conflict_other: {{way}} were modified on OSM meanwhile: nothing was written for their group. They have been removed from the queue; prepare again.

error.network: no network connection, or the OSM server cannot be reached. Nothing was lost: try again once connected.
error.auth: your OSM session has expired or the authorisation was revoked. Log in again; your queue is kept.
error.forbidden: OSM refused the request: the account may be blocked or must accept new terms on openstreetmap.org.
error.rateLimit: OSM limits how many edits a recent account can send per hour. Wait a little before sending the rest; your queue is kept.
error.bandwidth: too much data downloaded from OSM recently. Wait a few minutes before moving the map again.
error.maintenance: the OSM server is in maintenance (read-only). Try again later; your queue is kept.
error.tooBig: the area is too large or too dense to load the candidates: zoom in.
error.server: the OSM server returned an error. Try again later; your queue is kept.

nav.none: Every candidate in view has been visited.

mode.exitText_other: {{count}} changes have not been sent to OSM yet. If you keep them, they stay in this browser.
